og.title: CARSI Maintenance - Toolbox Talks (Monthly Refreshers)
og.description: Short, sharp Australian toolbox talks for professional floor-care teams. One topic per session, five minutes each, to keep the whole crew sharp between onboarding and re-certification. A new talk is added each month.

faq.q: How long does each toolbox talk take?
faq.a: Five minutes, with one topic per session. They are designed to be short and sharp so a whole crew can run one before starting work.

faq.q: What topics do the toolbox talks cover?
faq.a: Site arrival, chemical, PPE and SDS handling, machine and RCD safety, vehicle pre-start, wet-floor and hazard control, confidentiality and photos, cross-contamination, and slip resistance.

faq.q: Are the talks kept up to date?
faq.a: Yes. A new talk is added each month, so the series works as an ongoing refresher between onboarding and re-certification rather than a one-off session.

faq.q: Are these written for Australian workplaces?
faq.a: Yes. They are Australian-produced and reference 230 V and RCD safety, AS/NZS standards, Safe Work Australia guidance, and the Poisons Information line on 13 11 26.
